content:
Ask an enterprise AI team what is slowing them down.
They will say the model. The data. The talent.

It is almost never that.
It is the queue.

The same shape shows up in nearly every room I sit in:

→ A use case gets submitted by email
 ↳ Nobody actually owns the queue

 → It is reviewed at the same depth as a credit model
 ↳ Because there is only one depth

 → 18 days later a decision lands
 ↳ With no trail, and nothing reusable for the next one

Here is the part most leaders miss.
A slow governance function does not reduce risk.

→ It moves the risk to where you cannot see it
 ↳ The team with a deadline finds the tool that has no form
 ↳ That use case never enters your inventory
 ↳ You now own AI you cannot name

Shadow AI is not a discipline problem. 
It is a queue problem.

And the fix is not a lower bar.
→ Score the use case on the way in
 → Route by risk, not by habit
 ↳ Low risk clears in hours
 ↳ High risk finally gets the attention it deserved all along

Same bar. Sorted queue. Ten times the throughput.
That is the job Trustiblewas built for.
20 slides on where the bottleneck actually sits. 👇
#EnterpriseAI #AIGovernance #AIAdoption
